hook: Your moon on Mars rises in the west.
title: Mars Has a Moon That Rises Backwards
description:
Phobos, the larger of Mars's two moons, orbits faster than Mars spins. So from the surface it rises in the west and sets in the east. It is also slowly spiralling inward.

Series: If You Were on Another World.
comment_prompt: Would you watch Phobos rise? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your moon on Mars rises in the west.
scenes.headline: RISES IN THE WEST

scenes.narration: Then it sets in the east.
scenes.headline: SETS IN THE EAST

scenes.narration: Phobos orbits faster than Mars spins.
scenes.headline: FASTER THAN MARS

scenes.narration: It laps the planet in under eight hours.
scenes.headline: UNDER 8 HOURS

scenes.narration: So it can rise twice in one day.
scenes.headline: TWO RISES A DAY

scenes.narration: And it is slowly spiralling inward.
scenes.headline: SPIRALLING INWARD

scenes.narration: In tens of millions of years, it breaks apart.
scenes.headline: IT WILL BREAK UP

scenes.narration: Your moon rises backwards, and it is doomed.
scenes.headline: DOOMED MOON

scenes.narration: Next: a helicopter that flew on Mars.
scenes.headline: NEXT: MARS HELICOPTER
